# Post-Write Delta and Verification

The Awtsmoos renews every claim by evidence, not by pride;
Awtsmoos.com records both what was proven and what the tunnel could not visually provide.

## Original mission versus actual revelation

The original mission was to place a Daily Chitas Chumash study path into the existing Heichel Ikar road-read system as a special grouping, calculate the weekly parsha, divide it into seven daily readings, and follow the Chabad Chitas schedule.

The implementation uses the existing Living Path grouping contract instead of creating a parallel page. A stable `daily-chitas` grouping is synthesized only in `heichelId=ikar`, `seriesId=root`. Opening it loads a virtual series containing seven Sunday-through-Shabbos study cards.

## Calculation actually implemented

1. Use the browser-local civil date, not UTC.
2. Ask Hebcal for a 35-day forward calendar window with weekly parsha events.
3. Select the first event whose category is exactly `parashat`.
4. Read its full seven Shabbos aliyah boundaries from `leyning["1"]` through `leyning["7"]`.
5. Map Sunday through Shabbos to aliyos 1 through 7.
6. Festival Shabbos displacement therefore repeats the same upcoming Sidra automatically, matching Chabad's published Chitas rule.
7. Simchat Torah is kept explicit and its exact date page remains canonical at Chabad Daily Study.

## Planned versus actual file delta

The initial final plan expected the owner mutation change in `modules/ui/controls.js`. Import tracing proved that Living Path's public UI facade actually delegates governance rendering to `modules/ui/render/controls.js`. The real call target was changed instead; the similarly named helper was left alone.

The first rewrite of `ui/render/controls.js` exceeded the 120-line project ceiling. The architecture contract caught that failure. Rather than compressing comments or code, governance was split into:

- `ui/render/governance/control-plan.js`
- `ui/render/governance/create-controls.js`
- `ui/render/governance/series-controls.js`
- a small `ui/render/controls.js` coordinator

## Verification completed

- Daily Chitas schedule contract passes.
- Living Path integration contract passes.
- All changed source modules pass `node --check`.
- Source contract verifies B"H headers and at most 120 lines for all touched source modules.
- Fixture verifies Nitzavim-Vayeilech's seven aliyos for the week beginning August 30, 2026.
- Fixture verifies the Rosh Hashanah deferral: Thursday September 10, 2026 resolves to Ha'azinu aliyah 5, Deuteronomy 32:29-32:39.
- Public `https://awtsmoos.com/heichelos/ikar?view=groupings&series=root` returned HTTP 200.
- Public Heichel HTML references the live module-based Heichel application.
- Hebcal returned HTTP 200 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, proving browser-side calendar JSON is permitted cross-origin.
- Test stderr contains only Node's existing package-module-type warning; no test or syntax failure occurred.

## Verification not claimed

The tunnel's Chrome control is disabled, so no visual click-through screenshot was possible in this session. A later public static-module probe also timed out before device acceptance because the shared tunnel lane was congested; therefore I do not claim direct HTTP evidence for each newly created module URL even though the public Heichel itself and its module boot path were verified.

## Remaining work state

No known code defect remains from the implemented contracts. The only outstanding evidence is a visual browser click-through or a successful direct public fetch of the new module URLs once the tunnel/browser lane is available. That is verification debt, not an unimplemented feature.
